facts.variant: NE555; not NA555, SA555, SE555, TLC555 or LMC555
facts.conditions: Figure 6-2 topology: C charges through RA; THRES and DISCH join the capacitor node, TRIG is separate, RESET is held high. The threshold can terminate the interval only after TRIG has returned high. Source gives 10 us minimum monostable pulse width in this grounded-trigger storage context. Nominal threshold/control conditions and constant VCC during the interval apply; neither RC nominal values nor supply proportionality establish total timing tolerance.

facts.conditions: Approximate relationships for Figure 6-5 only, RA/RB in ohms and C in F. TRIG joins THRES at C; C charges through RA+RB and discharges through RB. Nominal capacitor swing is about 1/3 to 2/3 VCC. Driver duty is tL/T, waveform duty is tH/T, not interchangeable. Source recommends 100 kHz or below to reduce distortion, not a guaranteed accuracy or arbitrary duty-range entitlement. No alternate diode topology, changed CONT bias or CMOS part substitution is included.
